newsitem.title: USA: Federal-Mogul completes sale of subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Federal-Mogul completes sale of subsidiary.

text.p: Federal-Mogul Corp said Tuesday it completed the sale of its U.S. ball bearing business to NTN-BCA Corp, a member of NTN Group of Japan.

Under the agreement, Federal-Mogul received an undisclosed amount of cash and retained customer receivables. NTN acquired the remaining assets and assumed the liabilities of the ball bearing business conducted in Lititz, Pa., and Greensburg, Ind.
Federal-Signal said its annual sales to original equipment manufacturers will decline by nearly $50 million as a result of the sale. The effect on future earnings should be relatively neutral.
Federal-Mogul is a $2 billion global distributor and manufacturer of parts for automobiles, light and heavy trucks, and farm and construction vehicles.
